newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka John Keells up on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka John Keells up on retail buying.

text.p: Shares of Sri Lankan blue chip John Keells Holdings rose sharply on Tuesday by 12.75 rupees, or 4.4 pct, to 300 on increased retail buying, brokers said.

"The sharp rise is mainly due to retail interest in small quantities," said a broker with John Keells stock brokers. He said the price movement could also be attributed to better gorwth forecast for the company this year.
Dirk Tissera of Asia Capital said there were more John Keells shares on offer, but foreign buyers were looking at a lower price.
